events.name: Lake Mead Lodge Native Planting
events.description: Help Lake Mead's Song Dog Nursery restore the site of the former Lake Mead Lodge by planting native plants. Registered volunteers get the meeting spot and a free-entry password.

events.name: Bighorn Sheep Guzzler Cleanup
events.place: Lake Mead NRA (location sent on registration)
events.description: Support the park's native bighorn sheep by trimming vegetation around guzzlers, which provide a valuable water source for the herds. Space is limited.

events.name: International Volunteer Day Cleanup
events.place: Lake Mead NRA (location sent on registration)
events.description: Celebrate International Volunteer Day by cleaning up trash from a popular area of the park. Registered volunteers receive the location and a free-entry password.

events.name: Christmas Bird Count at Lake Mead
events.place: Lake Mead NRA (location sent on registration)
events.note: Beginners welcome; hike or boat survey routes. Registration required.
events.description: Join NPS biologists for the nation's longest-running community-science bird project, surveying birds of Lake Mead and Lake Mohave. Choose a hike or a (longer) boat survey route.

events.name: Hike 'N' Heal (Avery Burton Foundation)
events.place: Historic Railroad Trail access, Boulder City
events.note: Free; advance registration required, space limited.
events.description: The Avery Burton Foundation's 6th annual community hike on the Historic Railroad Trail, combining movement, reflection and mental-health awareness. Participants learn ABF's Recognize–Respond–Refer approach and get resources for supporting family and friends.
know: Final location, parking and prep details are emailed to registrants.
